correctness.rationale: Define F_a on the compact simplex using its continuous zero-flow extension. For any two active unequal components, writing their fixed sum as t and proportions x,1-x reduces to G_{a/t}(x); differentiating shows G has no interior noncentral maxima, with u/sinh(u) strictly decreasing. Thus any maximizer has k equal positive shares. Evaluating k e^{-ak} and the strictly ordered consecutive ratio ((k+1)/k)e^{-a} proves the unique support-count phase or exactly adjacent tie at a=log((k+1)/k). All parameter and boundary cases are covered analytically; 141230 programmatic diagnostic assertions are supplemental.

value.rationale: This exact all-n classification determines which subset of identical parallel eDNA-bearing reaches should carry fixed total experimental discharge to maximize tracer recovery, giving a complete no-skipped-support phase staircase and exact physically interpretable attenuation cutoffs. It illustrates how exponential travel-time loss creates a branch-shutdown incentive absent from linear survival assumptions, with arbitrary n and explicit equality cases. It is a theoretical laboratory benchmark, not an unsupported natural river recommendation.
